# Dairy-Free Cheesy Foods That Every Part of You Feels Good About

## Cheese Reimagined

Can you imagine a life without cheese? Sounds impossible, right? Now, picture a plant-based cheese
that's irresistibly rich and satisfyingly creamy. With us, it's not just possible — it's a
guarantee. You'll never have to live without the joy of cheese again.

#### Melty

#### Creamy

#### Stretchy

#### Cheesy
* ### Unbelievable Melt, Pure Indulgence
  
  Get ready for a melt that'll make you melt! Daiya's dairy-free cheese is a game-changer, melting
  flawlessly for that ooey-gooey satisfaction you love. Thanks to our Daiya Oat Cream™ blend, each
  bite is a creamy, dreamy delight. Who knew plant-based could taste this good and melt so right?

Dairy-Free Non-GMO No FOMO

## Cheese Bliss

Is there any comfort food more iconic than cheese? Our new dairy-free cheese melts impeccably,
offering a mouthwatering experience that stands out on its own… minus the actual dairy. Try melty,
mouthwatering shreds, slices, sticks, and more – all made extra delicious with the first-ever Daiya
Oat Cream™️ blend. Explore the whole starting lineup right here.
[ Discover Cheese ][40]

### Pizza Perfection

## About Earth Balance

[

### Who We Are

Our Colorado Roots

## Who We Are

### Our Colorado Roots

Born in Boulder, Colorado, in 1998, Earth Balance® started with a single innovative product: our
non-GMO, expeller-pressed Original Buttery Spread. This breakthrough creation gave vegans and food
lovers alike a chance to enjoy craveable, meltable, buttery goodness again.

We saw the joy brought by putting dairy-free buttery flavor on the menu for our plant-based eaters,
so we added more varieties to our line of spreads.

Then we came up with more delicious vegan baking products, like vegan buttery sticks, and began
offering vegan peanut butter spreads, adding variety in the grocery store–just for you. Today Earth
Balance offers spreads, sticks, nut butters, and snacks, all while remembering our humble
mountain-born beginnings.

[

### What We Believe

Our Food Philosophy

][16]

## What We Believe

### Our Food Philosophy

We believe in the power of Plant-Made. Basically, it means we make things from plants. But it means
other things, too, like integrity and mindfulness.

We know how important it is that plant-based baking, cooking, and snacking is accessible. That’s why
everything we make is vegan, meaning it's made using dairy-free ingredients and contains no animal
products.

[

### Did You Know?

We're Ethically Plant-Made

][17]

## Did You Know?

### We're Ethically Plant-Made

By making everything vegan and free of animal products, we make it easy to maintain a plant-based
food diet.

Many of our products are also Non-GMO Project Verified. Palm oil is a non-GMO, non-hydrogenated oil
we use to minimize separation in some of our products.

Any palm oil used in Earth Balance vegan products comes from Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil
(RSPO) member organizations, committed to environmentally and socially responsible palm oil
production. Our spreads are certified to the RSPO Mass Balance certification system¹.


*¹Conagra Brands began sourcing to the RSPO Mass Balance standards for spreads as of July 1, 2019.*

scrutiny over animal welfare, antibiotic use, and environmental impact, driving demand for
free-range and organic alternatives.

## Taking action for the future

As Arla farmers, we are dependent on nature and recognise our role in relation to climate change.
That’s why we are taking steps to develop how we farm and produce dairy for you and your family.

We work together to support ongoing improvements, including actions related to greenhouse gas
emissions and biodiversity. Want to know more?

[Get the full story][19]

## Rewarding farmers for climate-related actions

From August 2023, Arla farmers who implement activities related to greenhouse gas emissions can be
rewarded through the FarmAhead™ Incentive.

Together with our farmer owners, we have set a target to reduce CO2e emissions from milk and whey by
30.3 per cent by 2030. Rewarding farmers for implementing these activities is part of our approach
to supporting actions on farm.

In total, up to 500 million euro is allocated to support payments to Arla farmers for activities
included in the model, based on the current milk pool.

[Read more about FarmAhead™ Incentive][20]
[Rewarding farmers for climate-related actions]

## Committed to limiting global warming to 1.5°C

In December 2021, we doubled our climate target for operations including owned logistics from 30 to
63 per cent. This target has been approved by the Science Based Targets initiative as consistent
with reductions required in scopes 1 and 2 to keep global warming to 1.5°C. [The most ambitious goal
of the Paris Agreement][21].

[Learn more about our commitment to 1.5°C][22]
[Committed to limiting global warming to 1.5°C]

## Data-driven climate action

Arla farmers are working hard on making dairy more sustainable. Together, we are working towards
reducing the carbon footprint from milk and whey by 30.3% by 2030*.

To support them on the journey, we've created one of the **world’s largest externally
validated** **climate data sets** from dairy farms to help our farmer owners become as climate
efficient as possible.

**From a 2020 baseline*

[Learn more][23]

### Darey Brands ™

 

Darey Brands, Inc. is the parent company of leading specialty dairy brands: [Green Valley®][23] and
[Meyenberg®][24]. Our branded and private label products are sold nationwide at leading grocery,
mass, natural, specialty, and online retailers. Production occurs at multiple sites, yet primarily
in Sebastopol and Turlock, California. We also manufacture premium, plant-based dairy alternatives.
Darey Brands is wholly owned by Emmi Group, headquartered in Switzerland.

[darey-brands-girl-milk-1x1]

### What We Do

 

We are a national leader in sustainable and better-for-you specialty dairy. Our focus is on growing
innovative brands that offer consumers a broad range of product benefits— from environmentally
sustainable to easily digestible, nutrient-rich, and indulgent.

 

 

### What’s in a name?

 

Our founders were innovative pioneers in healthy eating and sustainable agriculture long before
these ideas became center-stage movements. Our name, **Darey Brands**, is not only a play on words,
but also a nod to our heritage and ethos. We proudly craft **Dairy That Dares to Be Different™.**

A full range of lactose-free dairy made from cow’s milk—perfect for sensitive digestion without
compromising on taste. From creamy yogurt and probiotic kefir to smooth sour cream, butter, and
cheese varieties like cream cheese and cottage cheese. Enjoy all the goodness of dairy, now easier
to digest. Naturally delicious, lactose-free.
[ Learn more ][25]
[Darey Brands: Brand Meyenberg 2]
Meyenberg
America's favorite goat milk brand since 1934. Products include fluid, powdered and evaporated milk
and delicious goat milk butter. We source our fresh milk from over 25 Certified Humane® California
dairies. Our dairy farm relationships built over the last several decades allow us to serve the
highest quality goat milk, and give access to the millions of people who love it.
[ Learn more ][26]
[Darey Brands Co-Packing]
Co-Packing and Private Label
With over a decade of expertise in crafting delicious plant-based dairy alternatives, Darey Brands
is your go-to partner for co-manufacturing and private label opportunities. We are here to develop
your ideal product — tailored to your needs, supported by our experience.

### What’s in a name?

 

Our founders were innovative pioneers in healthy eating and sustainable agriculture long before
these ideas became center-stage movements. Our name, **Darey Brands**, is not only a play on words,
but also a nod to our heritage and ethos. We proudly craft **Dairy That Dares to Be Different™.**

compromising on taste. From creamy yogurt and probiotic kefir to smooth sour cream, butter, and
cheese varieties like cream cheese and cottage cheese. Enjoy all the goodness of dairy, now easier
to digest. Naturally delicious, lactose-free.

## Learn how to eat real food and live a healthier life ... without going broke!

My husband and I started our marriage off in a great deal of debt. God saw us through that trial and
has challenged us to share what we’ve learned about finance, food and natural living with others who
struggle in this area. Why listen to me? I don't have letters after my name. I'm not a doctor, I
make mistakes and I burn dinner too. But I've been in the trenches and I know what it's like to need
help and not even know where to even begin. I figured my way out and learned lessons along the way.
This blog IS the lessons, and it's my goal for you to not be in those trenches alone without a way
to get out.

## Learn how to eat real food and live a healthier life ... without going broke!

My husband and I started our marriage off in a great deal of debt. God saw us through that trial and
has challenged us to share what we’ve learned about finance, food and natural living with others who
struggle in this area. Why listen to me? I don't have letters after my name. I'm not a doctor, I
make mistakes and I burn dinner too. But I've been in the trenches and I know what it's like to need
help and not even know where to even begin. I figured my way out and learned lessons along the way.
This blog IS the lessons, and it's my goal for you to not be in those trenches alone without a way
to get out.

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.

  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

# ***The* Prosoya Advantage**

#### **ProSoya Inc.** is a world leader in the **design, development and manufacture of plant,
#### equipment and machines** using advanced technology & know-how **for dairy alternatives like
#### soya milk, almond milk, oat milk, soya protein isolate and many more…** Based on our **
#### expertise and experience in extraction, formulation and dehydration technology,** ProSoya is a
#### complete solution provider for all your ** non dairy production needs, formulated beverages,
#### concentrates and powders.**

## ***About* Us**

ProSoya offers the best in dairy alternative technology through continual innovation and R & D, and
by building world class equipment to achieve the best quality product to meet the needs of the
customer and the consumer.

ProSoya technology employs a patented process that produces a smooth neutral tasting nutritionally
superior extract, which provides a flexible base for a variety of great tasting beverages. Our
dehydration technology is not only the most efficient but also produces one of the finest quality of
concentrates and instant powders.

With over 30 years of experience we are a perfect partner to your business. A partner you can trust
for quality and reliability, and that’s an advantage you will need to stay ahead of the competition…
The ProSoya Advantage.
 

## ***Research &* Development**

ProSoya’s success stems from continuing research and development complimented with exhaustive
testing and demonstration capability. In addition we have in-house facilities for product
development and trials runs supported by a team of highly experienced and motivated personnel. Our
Research and Development Centre is equipped with fully automated systems for extraction,
formulation, evaporation and drying technology where our customers can get a hand on experience of
what we offer.
 

### ***Our demonstration/testing facility has the following capabilities:***
* Dairy alternative extraction and processing technology for capacity up to 1000 l/hr of extract
  followed by blending, formulation, homogenization, UHT Sterilization and aseptic brick type
  packaging systems.
* Okara drying system (spin flash dryer).
* Evaporation system (for concentrates).
* Multi stage spray drying system (for powders).
* Aroma recovery system.
* Herbal extraction system (for instant herbal powders).

### ***Dairy Alternative Beverage Know-How***

ProSoya can assist you in producing great tasting beverages using the ProSoya Process. This unique
state-of-the-art patented technology utilizing airless cold grinding which prevents oxidation
related nutrition degradation, and flavor and mouth-feel problems. It’s the same technology that
established some of the best selling soymilk brands, including Silk in USA, SoNice in Canada,
SoyaTnuva in Israel and Staeta in India. Our improved beverages have smooth mouth-feel, outstanding
non-beany taste and excellent formulation to appeal to discriminating palate. Our juice-soy beverage

## The protein and probiotics of Greek yogurt. Minus the dairy.

We culture the world’s creamiest soymilk to make a dairy-free yogurt with 12g+ protein, 4g fiber,
and billions of probiotics.

## **The only dairy-free yogurt that can go
## spoon-for-spoon with Greek yogurt.**

[Frame Border 4]

## Made the way it should be.

Like Greek yogurt, we use the magic of cultures to transform milk into thick and tangy yogurt.

Only we start with dairy-free milk from whole, organic soybeans—earth's best plant protein.

🚫 No GMOs, no protein isolates, no oils, no artificial sweeteners, no nonsense.

## With billions of live and active cultures in each little cup.

We culture our yogurt with some of the most studied probiotic strains in the world, including *L.
bulgaricus*, *S. thermophilus*,* L. lactis, L. acidophilus*, and *B. lactis*.

They're proven to support your digestion, gut, and immune system.

## We believe food should heal our bodies and planet.

For thousands of years, human civilizations have turned to soybeans for powerful nutrition and
balance with the environment. That’s because they have some magical qualities:
* The King Of Plant Proteins
  
  Soybeans are the only plant high in complete, fully digestible protein—like dairy protein. That
  means: 
  
  (1) Soybeans are 40% protein—that's more protein-dense than an egg
  
  (2) They contain all 9 essential amino acids
  
  (3) Our bodies easily digest the protein in soybeans, as measured by near their perfect PDCAAS.
  
  Other plant milks are mostly carbohydrates and fat with little and lower quality protein.
  
  Plus, soybeans are full of gut-healthy fiber.
* In Harmony With Mother Nature
  
  When it comes to the planet, soybeans are givers not takers.
  
  Soybeans enrich soil with nitrogen, a nutrient essential for all life.
  
  And they do that while using using ~90% less land, water, and pollution than traditional dairy
  milk (J. Poore and T. Nemecek, 2018, OurWorldinData.org).
  
  We only use non-gmo, organic soybeans that are grown in harmony with the land, without synthetic
  fertilizers, pesticides, or herbicides.

Only we start with dairy-free milk from whole, organic soybeans—earth's best plant protein.

🚫 No GMOs, no protein isolates, no oils, no artificial sweeteners, no nonsense.

We culture our yogurt with some of the most studied probiotic strains in the world, including *L.

They're proven to support your digestion, gut, and immune system.

## We believe food should heal our bodies and planet.

For thousands of years, human civilizations have turned to soybeans for powerful nutrition and
balance with the environment. That’s because they have some magical qualities:
* The King Of Plant Proteins
  
  Soybeans are the only plant high in complete, fully digestible protein—like dairy protein. That
  means: 
  
  (1) Soybeans are 40% protein—that's more protein-dense than an egg
  
  (2) They contain all 9 essential amino acids
  
  (3) Our bodies easily digest the protein in soybeans, as measured by near their perfect PDCAAS.
  
  Other plant milks are mostly carbohydrates and fat with little and lower quality protein.
  
  Plus, soybeans are full of gut-healthy fiber.
* In Harmony With Mother Nature
  
  When it comes to the planet, soybeans are givers not takers.
  
  Soybeans enrich soil with nitrogen, a nutrient essential for all life.
  
  And they do that while using using ~90% less land, water, and pollution than traditional dairy
  milk (J. Poore and T. Nemecek, 2018, OurWorldinData.org).
  
  We only use non-gmo, organic soybeans that are grown in harmony with the land, without synthetic
  fertilizers, pesticides, or herbicides.

## Wholesale List

Welcome to Wholesalers Network.com. Our website contains a growing number of wholesale product
categories to choose from and thousands of wholesale companies on our B2B search directory. If
you’re a business looking to find some wholesale merchandise to sell online or offline then you can
start your search by clicking on the category of your choice or browse [wholesalers by country][9].
If you’re a business looking to get exposure for your wholesale company website you should visit
our [Company Submission][10] page. We also offer Advertising options for your wholesale company if
you want to maximize your exposure.

## Expanding Opportunities in the B2B Digital Landscape

In the world of wholesale and B2B commerce, access to reliable suppliers and structured directories
plays a crucial role in business growth. Platforms like provide businesses with the ability to
explore thousands of suppliers across multiple categories, helping retailers and entrepreneurs find
the right products to sell both online and offline.

As competition continues to increase, businesses must go beyond simply sourcing products—they need
to build efficient systems, maintain strong supplier relationships, and stay informed about market
trends. A well-organized sourcing strategy allows companies to reduce risks, improve margins, and
create more стабильный and scalable operations over time.

At the same time, the broader digital ecosystem continues to evolve, offering a wide variety of
platforms and services that reflect changing user behavior and global connectivity. From e-commerce
and logistics to entertainment and interactive platforms, each sector contributes to a more diverse
online environment.

Websites such as **[luckyspy.co.uk][11]** are part of this expanding digital landscape,
demonstrating how modern online platforms are designed to engage users and provide accessible
experiences across different industries.

For businesses operating in wholesale and distribution, understanding these broader trends can offer
valuable insights. By observing how digital platforms grow, attract users, and scale globally,
companies can apply similar principles to their own strategies and remain competitive in a rapidly
changing market.

Ultimately, success in B2B commerce comes from combining reliable sourcing, strategic thinking, and
adaptability. Those who continuously refine their processes and stay open to new opportunities will
be best positioned to grow and succeed in today’s interconnected world.

## Rein pflanzlicher Genuss

#### mit unseren vielfach ausgezeichneten Käse-Alternativen für eine leckere vegane Ernährung

Unsere Wilmersburger Scheiben gewannen 2013 den vegan.at-Award in der Kategorie „Cheesy“ und setzten
sich als beliebtestes veganes Produkt im Wettbewerb durch. Im selben Jahr konnten wir ebenfalls den
Progress Award von Peta für uns entscheiden und erhielten eine Auszeichnung für „tierischen“
Fortschritt in Wirtschaft, Kultur, Wissenschaft und Ernährung. Wir haben uns sehr gefreut den Titel
„bester veganer Käse“ tragen zu dürfen und damit unseren Beitrag für weniger Tierleid zu leisten.
Dieser Titel bestätigte sich als wir 2014 den Liberation Award von Peta2.de in der Kategorie „beste
Käsealternative“ gewannen.
Wilmersburger ist die vegane Alternative zu Käse. "Veganer Käse" gibt es nicht, doch wer Käse mag,
wird Wilmersburger lieben.

"Bei der Umstellung auf eine vegane Ernährungsweise fiel mir der Verzicht auf Käse am schwersten.
Dabei habe ich lange nach einer geschmackvollen Alternative zum Überbacken gesucht und endlich
Wilmersburger gefunden. Vielen Dank für Eure leckeren Scheiben, den Pizzaschmelz und überhaupt, dass
es Wilmersburger gibt."

Maren Huber

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.
Use it when you want a differentiated product without owning a factory. The formula is typically
co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.

You select an existing product the manufacturer already produces and apply your branding. Use it

## Cheese Reimagined

Can you imagine a life without cheese? Sounds impossible, right? Now, picture a plant-based cheese
that's irresistibly rich and satisfyingly creamy. With us, it's not just possible — it's a
guarantee. You'll never have to live without the joy of cheese again.

* ### Unbelievable Melt, Pure Indulgence
  
  Get ready for a melt that'll make you melt! Daiya's dairy-free cheese is a game-changer, melting
  flawlessly for that ooey-gooey satisfaction you love. Thanks to our Daiya Oat Cream™ blend, each
  bite is a creamy, dreamy delight. Who knew plant-based could taste this good and melt so right?

Dairy-Free Non-GMO No FOMO

## Cheese Bliss

Is there any comfort food more iconic than cheese? Our new dairy-free cheese melts impeccably,
offering a mouthwatering experience that stands out on its own… minus the actual dairy. Try melty,
mouthwatering shreds, slices, sticks, and more – all made extra delicious with the first-ever Daiya
Oat Cream™️ blend. Explore the whole starting lineup right here.
[ Discover Cheese ][40]

### Pizza Perfection

Why can't every night be pizza night? With Daiya, it can be! Each bite of our pizza is plant-based
perfection: featuring a crisp, thin crust, melty dairy-free cheese, and a perfectly balanced amount
of toppings.

[ Explore Pizza & Flatbread ][41]

### Mac & Cheese Magic

Mac & Cheese is *peak* nostalgia. Our dairy-free Mac & Cheese is no exception, incredibly melty,
exceptionally creamy, and bursting with rich cheesy goodness. One bite and you'll be transported
back to simpler times.

[ Explore Mac & Cheese ][42]

## The Daiya Way
* Inclusive Indulgence
  
  ### Deliciously Easy, Incredibly Cheesy
  
  Maybe it's our Pacific Northwest roots, maybe it's just being realistic, but at Daiya, we're about
  creating delicious moments that everyone can feel good about—plant-devotees, the plant-curious,
  and cheese aficionados alike. We're bridging the gap with our Daiya Oat Cream™ blend, ensuring
  that choosing Daiya means indulging in creamy, melty, and rich flavors crafted from plants. This
  is comfort food meant to be relished by all. So, let's raise a toast to a world where cheese
  doesn't come with conditions, and every bite is a celebration of taste and choice.

## About Earth Balance

[

### Who We Are

Our Colorado Roots

## Who We Are

### Our Colorado Roots

Born in Boulder, Colorado, in 1998, Earth Balance® started with a single innovative product: our
non-GMO, expeller-pressed Original Buttery Spread. This breakthrough creation gave vegans and food
lovers alike a chance to enjoy craveable, meltable, buttery goodness again.

We saw the joy brought by putting dairy-free buttery flavor on the menu for our plant-based eaters,
so we added more varieties to our line of spreads.

Then we came up with more delicious vegan baking products, like vegan buttery sticks, and began
offering vegan peanut butter spreads, adding variety in the grocery store–just for you. Today Earth
Balance offers spreads, sticks, nut butters, and snacks, all while remembering our humble
mountain-born beginnings.

[

### What We Believe

Our Food Philosophy

][16]

## What We Believe

### Our Food Philosophy

We believe in the power of Plant-Made. Basically, it means we make things from plants. But it means
other things, too, like integrity and mindfulness.

We know how important it is that plant-based baking, cooking, and snacking is accessible. That’s why
everything we make is vegan, meaning it's made using dairy-free ingredients and contains no animal
products.

[

### Did You Know?

We're Ethically Plant-Made

][17]

## Did You Know?

### We're Ethically Plant-Made

By making everything vegan and free of animal products, we make it easy to maintain a plant-based
food diet.

Many of our products are also Non-GMO Project Verified. Palm oil is a non-GMO, non-hydrogenated oil
we use to minimize separation in some of our products.

Any palm oil used in Earth Balance vegan products comes from Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil
(RSPO) member organizations, committed to environmentally and socially responsible palm oil
production. Our spreads are certified to the RSPO Mass Balance certification system¹.


*¹Conagra Brands began sourcing to the RSPO Mass Balance standards for spreads as of July 1, 2019.*

## Taking action for the future

As Arla farmers, we are dependent on nature and recognise our role in relation to climate change.
That’s why we are taking steps to develop how we farm and produce dairy for you and your family.

We work together to support ongoing improvements, including actions related to greenhouse gas
emissions and biodiversity. Want to know more?

[Get the full story][19]

## Rewarding farmers for climate-related actions

From August 2023, Arla farmers who implement activities related to greenhouse gas emissions can be
rewarded through the FarmAhead™ Incentive.

Together with our farmer owners, we have set a target to reduce CO2e emissions from milk and whey by
30.3 per cent by 2030. Rewarding farmers for implementing these activities is part of our approach
to supporting actions on farm.

In total, up to 500 million euro is allocated to support payments to Arla farmers for activities
included in the model, based on the current milk pool.

[Read more about FarmAhead™ Incentive][20]
[Rewarding farmers for climate-related actions]

## Committed to limiting global warming to 1.5°C

In December 2021, we doubled our climate target for operations including owned logistics from 30 to
63 per cent. This target has been approved by the Science Based Targets initiative as consistent
with reductions required in scopes 1 and 2 to keep global warming to 1.5°C. [The most ambitious goal
of the Paris Agreement][21].

[Learn more about our commitment to 1.5°C][22]
[Committed to limiting global warming to 1.5°C]

## Data-driven climate action

Arla farmers are working hard on making dairy more sustainable. Together, we are working towards
reducing the carbon footprint from milk and whey by 30.3% by 2030*.

To support them on the journey, we've created one of the **world’s largest externally
validated** **climate data sets** from dairy farms to help our farmer owners become as climate
efficient as possible.

**From a 2020 baseline*

[Learn more][23]
[Data-driven climate action]

### Darey Brands ™

 

Darey Brands, Inc. is the parent company of leading specialty dairy brands: [Green Valley®][23] and
[Meyenberg®][24]. Our branded and private label products are sold nationwide at leading grocery,
mass, natural, specialty, and online retailers. Production occurs at multiple sites, yet primarily
in Sebastopol and Turlock, California. We also manufacture premium, plant-based dairy alternatives.
Darey Brands is wholly owned by Emmi Group, headquartered in Switzerland.

[darey-brands-girl-milk-1x1]

### What We Do

 

We are a national leader in sustainable and better-for-you specialty dairy. Our focus is on growing
innovative brands that offer consumers a broad range of product benefits— from environmentally
sustainable to easily digestible, nutrient-rich, and indulgent.

 

 

### What’s in a name?

 

Our founders were innovative pioneers in healthy eating and sustainable agriculture long before
these ideas became center-stage movements. Our name, **Darey Brands**, is not only a play on words,
but also a nod to our heritage and ethos. We proudly craft **Dairy That Dares to Be Different™.**

Green Valley Lactose Free
A full range of lactose-free dairy made from cow’s milk—perfect for sensitive digestion without
compromising on taste. From creamy yogurt and probiotic kefir to smooth sour cream, butter, and
cheese varieties like cream cheese and cottage cheese. Enjoy all the goodness of dairy, now easier
to digest. Naturally delicious, lactose-free.
[ Learn more ][25]
[Darey Brands: Brand Meyenberg 2]
Meyenberg
America's favorite goat milk brand since 1934. Products include fluid, powdered and evaporated milk
and delicious goat milk butter. We source our fresh milk from over 25 Certified Humane® California
dairies. Our dairy farm relationships built over the last several decades allow us to serve the
highest quality goat milk, and give access to the millions of people who love it.
[ Learn more ][26]

Co-Packing and Private Label
With over a decade of expertise in crafting delicious plant-based dairy alternatives, Darey Brands
is your go-to partner for co-manufacturing and private label opportunities. We are here to develop
your ideal product — tailored to your needs, supported by our experience.

## About Darey Brands™

Darey Brands, Inc. is the parent company of leading specialty dairy brands: [Green Valley®][38] and
[Meyenberg®][39]. Our branded and private label products are sold nationwide at leading grocery,
mass, natural, specialty, and online retailers. Production occurs at multiple sites, yet primarily
in Sebastopol and Turlock, California. We also manufacture premium, plant-based dairy alternatives.
Darey Brands is wholly owned by Emmi Group, headquartered in Switzerland.

## Learn how to eat real food and live a healthier life ... without going broke!

My husband and I started our marriage off in a great deal of debt. God saw us through that trial and
has challenged us to share what we’ve learned about finance, food and natural living with others who
struggle in this area. Why listen to me? I don't have letters after my name. I'm not a doctor, I
make mistakes and I burn dinner too. But I've been in the trenches and I know what it's like to need
help and not even know where to even begin. I figured my way out and learned lessons along the way.
This blog IS the lessons, and it's my goal for you to not be in those trenches alone without a way
to get out.

make mistakes and I burn dinner too. But I've been in the trenches and I know what it's like to need
help and not even know where to even begin. I figured my way out and learned lessons along the way.
This blog IS the lessons, and it's my goal for you to not be in those trenches alone without a way
to get out.

* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story

  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.

  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

# ***The* Prosoya Advantage**

#### **ProSoya Inc.** is a world leader in the **design, development and manufacture of plant,
#### equipment and machines** using advanced technology & know-how **for dairy alternatives like
#### soya milk, almond milk, oat milk, soya protein isolate and many more…** Based on our **
#### expertise and experience in extraction, formulation and dehydration technology,** ProSoya is a
#### complete solution provider for all your ** non dairy production needs, formulated beverages,
#### concentrates and powders.**

## ***About* Us**

ProSoya offers the best in dairy alternative technology through continual innovation and R & D, and
by building world class equipment to achieve the best quality product to meet the needs of the
customer and the consumer.

ProSoya technology employs a patented process that produces a smooth neutral tasting nutritionally
superior extract, which provides a flexible base for a variety of great tasting beverages. Our
dehydration technology is not only the most efficient but also produces one of the finest quality of
concentrates and instant powders.

With over 30 years of experience we are a perfect partner to your business. A partner you can trust
for quality and reliability, and that’s an advantage you will need to stay ahead of the competition…
The ProSoya Advantage.
 

## ***Research &* Development**

ProSoya’s success stems from continuing research and development complimented with exhaustive
testing and demonstration capability. In addition we have in-house facilities for product
development and trials runs supported by a team of highly experienced and motivated personnel. Our
Research and Development Centre is equipped with fully automated systems for extraction,
formulation, evaporation and drying technology where our customers can get a hand on experience of
what we offer.
 

### ***Our demonstration/testing facility has the following capabilities:***
* Dairy alternative extraction and processing technology for capacity up to 1000 l/hr of extract
  followed by blending, formulation, homogenization, UHT Sterilization and aseptic brick type
  packaging systems.
* Okara drying system (spin flash dryer).
* Evaporation system (for concentrates).
* Multi stage spray drying system (for powders).
* Aroma recovery system.
* Herbal extraction system (for instant herbal powders).

### ***Dairy Alternative Beverage Know-How***

ProSoya can assist you in producing great tasting beverages using the ProSoya Process. This unique
state-of-the-art patented technology utilizing airless cold grinding which prevents oxidation
related nutrition degradation, and flavor and mouth-feel problems. It’s the same technology that
established some of the best selling soymilk brands, including Silk in USA, SoNice in Canada,
SoyaTnuva in Israel and Staeta in India. Our improved beverages have smooth mouth-feel, outstanding
non-beany taste and excellent formulation to appeal to discriminating palate. Our juice-soy beverage
and smoothie formulations with up to 7 g protein per 250 ml serving have absolutely no soy taste.
Creamsicle (Unilever Trademark) like taste of Creamy Orange is loved by mainstream consumers of all
ages. We have now added great tasting Peach Mango and Pineapple Banana smoothies. These are hit at
any party, with or without added sodas or/and alcohol. Also, we have traditional formulations:
Original or Plain, Vanilla, Chocolate, Mocha, Orange Shake, Strawberry Shake, etc..

## ## ***Our* Customers**

ProSoya technology is currently being used in more than **50 countries**. Our customers include
**DuPont, Kraft, Soya World, SunOpta, Unilever, Hershey’s and many more.**. Many bestselling brands,
including **Silk in the US, SoNice in Canada, SoyaTnuva in Israel and Staeta in India** have been
established using ProSoya’s patented technology and know-how. There are large-scale processing
plants in **Bolivia, Canada, Germany, India, Iran, Israel, Russia and USA**. Over 1000 small, to
medium-scale plants are located all around the world.

## ***About* Us**

ProSoya offers the best in dairy alternative technology through continual innovation and R & D, and
by building world class equipment to achieve the best quality product to meet the needs of the
customer and the consumer.

ProSoya technology employs a patented process that produces a smooth neutral tasting nutritionally
superior extract, which provides a flexible base for a variety of great tasting beverages. Our
dehydration technology is not only the most efficient but also produces one of the finest quality of
concentrates and instant powders.

With over 30 years of experience we are a perfect partner to your business. A partner you can trust
for quality and reliability, and that’s an advantage you will need to stay ahead of the competition…
The ProSoya Advantage.
 

## ***Research &* Development**

ProSoya’s success stems from continuing research and development complimented with exhaustive
testing and demonstration capability. In addition we have in-house facilities for product
development and trials runs supported by a team of highly experienced and motivated personnel. Our
Research and Development Centre is equipped with fully automated systems for extraction,
formulation, evaporation and drying technology where our customers can get a hand on experience of
what we offer.
 

### ***Our demonstration/testing facility has the following capabilities:***
* Dairy alternative extraction and processing technology for capacity up to 1000 l/hr of extract
  followed by blending, formulation, homogenization, UHT Sterilization and aseptic brick type
  packaging systems.
* Okara drying system (spin flash dryer).
* Evaporation system (for concentrates).
* Multi stage spray drying system (for powders).
* Aroma recovery system.
* Herbal extraction system (for instant herbal powders).

### ***Dairy Alternative Beverage Know-How***

ProSoya can assist you in producing great tasting beverages using the ProSoya Process. This unique
state-of-the-art patented technology utilizing airless cold grinding which prevents oxidation
related nutrition degradation, and flavor and mouth-feel problems. It’s the same technology that
established some of the best selling soymilk brands, including Silk in USA, SoNice in Canada,
SoyaTnuva in Israel and Staeta in India. Our improved beverages have smooth mouth-feel, outstanding
non-beany taste and excellent formulation to appeal to discriminating palate. Our juice-soy beverage
and smoothie formulations with up to 7 g protein per 250 ml serving have absolutely no soy taste.
Creamsicle (Unilever Trademark) like taste of Creamy Orange is loved by mainstream consumers of all
ages. We have now added great tasting Peach Mango and Pineapple Banana smoothies. These are hit at
any party, with or without added sodas or/and alcohol. Also, we have traditional formulations:
Original or Plain, Vanilla, Chocolate, Mocha, Orange Shake, Strawberry Shake, etc..

## ## ***Our* Customers**

ProSoya technology is currently being used in more than **50 countries**. Our customers include
**DuPont, Kraft, Soya World, SunOpta, Unilever, Hershey’s and many more.**. Many bestselling brands,
including **Silk in the US, SoNice in Canada, SoyaTnuva in Israel and Staeta in India** have been
established using ProSoya’s patented technology and know-how. There are large-scale processing
plants in **Bolivia, Canada, Germany, India, Iran, Israel, Russia and USA**. Over 1000 small, to
medium-scale plants are located all around the world.

We culture the world’s creamiest soymilk to make a dairy-free yogurt with 12g+ protein, 4g fiber,
and billions of probiotics.

## **The only dairy-free yogurt that can go
## spoon-for-spoon with Greek yogurt.**

[Frame Border 4]

## Made the way it should be.

Like Greek yogurt, we use the magic of cultures to transform milk into thick and tangy yogurt.

Only we start with dairy-free milk from whole, organic soybeans—earth's best plant protein.

🚫 No GMOs, no protein isolates, no oils, no artificial sweeteners, no nonsense.

## With billions of live and active cultures in each little cup.

We culture our yogurt with some of the most studied probiotic strains in the world, including *L.
bulgaricus*, *S. thermophilus*,* L. lactis, L. acidophilus*, and *B. lactis*.

They're proven to support your digestion, gut, and immune system.

## We believe food should heal our bodies and planet.

For thousands of years, human civilizations have turned to soybeans for powerful nutrition and
balance with the environment. That’s because they have some magical qualities:
* The King Of Plant Proteins
  
  Soybeans are the only plant high in complete, fully digestible protein—like dairy protein. That
  means: 
  
  (1) Soybeans are 40% protein—that's more protein-dense than an egg
  
  (2) They contain all 9 essential amino acids
  
  (3) Our bodies easily digest the protein in soybeans, as measured by near their perfect PDCAAS.
  
  Other plant milks are mostly carbohydrates and fat with little and lower quality protein.
  
  Plus, soybeans are full of gut-healthy fiber.
* In Harmony With Mother Nature
  
  When it comes to the planet, soybeans are givers not takers.
  
  Soybeans enrich soil with nitrogen, a nutrient essential for all life.
  
  And they do that while using using ~90% less land, water, and pollution than traditional dairy
  milk (J. Poore and T. Nemecek, 2018, OurWorldinData.org).
  
  We only use non-gmo, organic soybeans that are grown in harmony with the land, without synthetic
  fertilizers, pesticides, or herbicides.

## We believe food should heal our bodies and planet.

For thousands of years, human civilizations have turned to soybeans for powerful nutrition and
balance with the environment. That’s because they have some magical qualities:
* The King Of Plant Proteins
  
  Soybeans are the only plant high in complete, fully digestible protein—like dairy protein. That
  means: 
  
  (1) Soybeans are 40% protein—that's more protein-dense than an egg
  
  (2) They contain all 9 essential amino acids
  
  (3) Our bodies easily digest the protein in soybeans, as measured by near their perfect PDCAAS.
  
  Other plant milks are mostly carbohydrates and fat with little and lower quality protein.
  
  Plus, soybeans are full of gut-healthy fiber.
* In Harmony With Mother Nature
  
  When it comes to the planet, soybeans are givers not takers.
  
  Soybeans enrich soil with nitrogen, a nutrient essential for all life.
  
  And they do that while using using ~90% less land, water, and pollution than traditional dairy
  milk (J. Poore and T. Nemecek, 2018, OurWorldinData.org).
  
  We only use non-gmo, organic soybeans that are grown in harmony with the land, without synthetic
  fertilizers, pesticides, or herbicides.

## Made the way it should be.

Like Greek yogurt, we use the magic of cultures to transform milk into thick and tangy yogurt.

Only we start with dairy-free milk from whole, organic soybeans—earth's best plant protein.

🚫 No GMOs, no protein isolates, no oils, no artificial sweeteners, no nonsense.

## With billions of live and active cultures in each little cup.

We culture our yogurt with some of the most studied probiotic strains in the world, including *L.
bulgaricus*, *S. thermophilus*,* L. lactis, L. acidophilus*, and *B. lactis*.

They're proven to support your digestion, gut, and immune system.

## Wholesale List

Welcome to Wholesalers Network.com. Our website contains a growing number of wholesale product
categories to choose from and thousands of wholesale companies on our B2B search directory. If
you’re a business looking to find some wholesale merchandise to sell online or offline then you can
start your search by clicking on the category of your choice or browse [wholesalers by country][9].
If you’re a business looking to get exposure for your wholesale company website you should visit
our [Company Submission][10] page. We also offer Advertising options for your wholesale company if
you want to maximize your exposure.

## Expanding Opportunities in the B2B Digital Landscape

In the world of wholesale and B2B commerce, access to reliable suppliers and structured directories
plays a crucial role in business growth. Platforms like provide businesses with the ability to
explore thousands of suppliers across multiple categories, helping retailers and entrepreneurs find
the right products to sell both online and offline.

As competition continues to increase, businesses must go beyond simply sourcing products—they need
to build efficient systems, maintain strong supplier relationships, and stay informed about market
trends. A well-organized sourcing strategy allows companies to reduce risks, improve margins, and
create more стабильный and scalable operations over time.

At the same time, the broader digital ecosystem continues to evolve, offering a wide variety of
platforms and services that reflect changing user behavior and global connectivity. From e-commerce
and logistics to entertainment and interactive platforms, each sector contributes to a more diverse
online environment.

Websites such as **[luckyspy.co.uk][11]** are part of this expanding digital landscape,
demonstrating how modern online platforms are designed to engage users and provide accessible
experiences across different industries.

For businesses operating in wholesale and distribution, understanding these broader trends can offer
valuable insights. By observing how digital platforms grow, attract users, and scale globally,
companies can apply similar principles to their own strategies and remain competitive in a rapidly
changing market.

Ultimately, success in B2B commerce comes from combining reliable sourcing, strategic thinking, and
adaptability. Those who continuously refine their processes and stay open to new opportunities will
be best positioned to grow and succeed in today’s interconnected world.

## Rein pflanzlicher Genuss

#### mit unseren vielfach ausgezeichneten Käse-Alternativen für eine leckere vegane Ernährung

Unsere Wilmersburger Scheiben gewannen 2013 den vegan.at-Award in der Kategorie „Cheesy“ und setzten
sich als beliebtestes veganes Produkt im Wettbewerb durch. Im selben Jahr konnten wir ebenfalls den
Progress Award von Peta für uns entscheiden und erhielten eine Auszeichnung für „tierischen“
Fortschritt in Wirtschaft, Kultur, Wissenschaft und Ernährung. Wir haben uns sehr gefreut den Titel
„bester veganer Käse“ tragen zu dürfen und damit unseren Beitrag für weniger Tierleid zu leisten.
Dieser Titel bestätigte sich als wir 2014 den Liberation Award von Peta2.de in der Kategorie „beste
Käsealternative“ gewannen.
Wilmersburger ist die vegane Alternative zu Käse. "Veganer Käse" gibt es nicht, doch wer Käse mag,
wird Wilmersburger lieben.

"Bei der Umstellung auf eine vegane Ernährungsweise fiel mir der Verzicht auf Käse am schwersten.
Dabei habe ich lange nach einer geschmackvollen Alternative zum Überbacken gesucht und endlich
Wilmersburger gefunden. Vielen Dank für Eure leckeren Scheiben, den Pizzaschmelz und überhaupt, dass
es Wilmersburger gibt."

Maren Huber

Manufacturing models

## Three ways to make your product

### Private label

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.
Use it when you want a differentiated product without owning a factory. The formula is typically
co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.
